setup_graph_parallel_groups: setup graph parallel and data parallel process groups for distributed training with a specified group size
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: reduce tensors across the graph parallel region using all_reduce for model parallel training
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter input tensors across graph parallel ranks by splitting along the first dimension
gather_from_model_parallel_region: gather tensors from all graph parallel ranks and concatenate them with proper padding handling
scale_backward_grad: scale backward gradients by the graph parallel world size to correct DDP mean reduction
